item.title: Release XSpec v4.0.2
item.description: Release XSpec v4.0.2 XSpec 4.0 supports testing your XProc 3 code and enhances the XProc harness for running test suites. These are the highlights of XSpec v4.0: Common to Languages Under Test The XProc 3 pipelines for running XSpec tests can produce JUnit reports on the new junit output port. To produce JUnit reports, set the junit-enabled option to 'true'. The XProc 3 pipelines for running XSpec tests have a new inline-css option with default value 'true', making the HTML report of test results a self-contained file.
